rule.aligned_form: z=[2]+token_ids+[3]; labeled columns j=0..len(token_ids) (column j predicts z[j+1]); count per row = len(token_ids)+1
rule.disjointness: exact token-array inequality vs first-128 ENGLISH_DEV.jsonl monitor rows and vs all 16 SF1 TRAIN prompt_token_ids arrays; violations => STOP
rule.ordering: row-major over retained rows in file order
rule.per_update_rotation: English update u in 1..180 -> start=((u-1)*160) mod |P|; take next 160 entries of P (wrap at end)
rule.retention_filter: rows with 2 <= len(token_ids) <= 254, in file order
